description: PowerOutage.com collects, records and aggregates live power outage data from electric utilities, and states that it tracks outages for 94 percent of US, 95 percent of Canadian and 89 percent of UK electricity customers. A free public outage map is online, and the business products are a live outage REST API updated every 10 minutes for the US, Canada and the UK, which also returns GeoJSON outage shapes taken from utility providers; an embeddable live outage map; text and email alerts with count thresholds for chosen areas; customised CSV outage reports; and historical outage data down to city level at intervals as short as 10 minutes, extending partially back to 2016. Pricing is on request by email and no licence text is published on the page read. Coverage is the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom, with expansion to other countries announced. Caveats: data are gathered from many utilities so coverage and definitions may vary by utility, history before recent years is partial, and use terms are not public. Simulation uses are observed outage and restoration curves by area for calibrating storm, heat and wildfire outage and recovery models. Related records: data-eagle-i-recorded-electricity-outages-us-counties is the federal US county outage record.
